dialog: Speaker Joanna says: [Image: a photo of a person holding a clap board with a dog sleeping in a dog bed] Nate, can you believe it? I'm finally filming my own movie from the road-trip script!

Speaker Nate says: Congrats, Joanna! Not surprised at all that your hard work paid off. Must feel awesome to see your script come alive in a movie! Pretty cool when something you love brings success, right? Tell me more about your movie!
Speaker Joanna says: Woohoo, thanks Nate! It's pretty wild to see it come alive. Every day on set is awesome and full of potential. Being able to show my vision is awesome.
Speaker Nate says: I think so too! What's been the coolest moment on set?
Speaker Joanna says: One of the actors came up to me and told me how much she liked my script! I was so excited when that happened - it gave me chills!

Speaker Nate says: Wow Joanna, that must have been so exciting! It's incredible when you get those moments of joy. Anyway, I took my turtles to the beach in Tampa yesterday! They always bring me peace in the craziness of life.
Speaker Joanna says: Woah, that's awesome, Nate! You must really enjoy having them around - they're so cool! What do you love most about having them?

Speaker Nate says: [Image: a photo of a turtle sitting on a log in a pond] Your completely right! I really love having them around. They're so cool and they make me feel calm. Plus, they don't require much looking after, which is great. I love seeing them soaking in the sun like this.
Speaker Joanna says: That's awesome, Nate! They look so serene and happy. It's great to have something like that.

Speaker Nate says: [Image: a photography of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon in it] Yeah, turtles are like zen masters! They always remind me to slow down and appreciate the small things in life. I'm loving experimenting with flavors right now. Here are some colorful bowls of coconut milk ice cream that I made.
Speaker Joanna says: Hey Nate, that looks really yummy! The colors and mix-ins give it a nice kick.
Speaker Nate says: Nice! I'm glad you like it too. This recipe really jazzes it up. Wanna give it a try?
Speaker Joanna says: Definitely, Nate! That ice cream looks mouthwatering. Thanks so much for offering!
Speaker Nate says: No worries, Joanna. Hope you enjoy it!
Speaker Joanna says: Yea, no worries! It was great catching up. Take it easy!
